about: Image-to-video prompts for the film's scenes: hyper-realistic live action, each clip starting from the still of the same name (start frame), 16:9, no audio (the film has its own narration and score). Saved as media/legend/<shot>.mp4; scripts/legend-video.py cuts them to the narration. A shot without a clip falls back to its still.

shots.prompt: Hyper-realistic live-action film shot. An ancient leather-bound tome lies open on a dark oak desk beside a brass armillary sphere, a steaming mug, a lit candle and a coiled modern charging cable. Steam curls from the mug; one page slowly lifts and turns over on its own; the sphere turns very slowly. The candle flame burns steady. Slow, smooth push-in. 35mm film, shallow depth of field, warm practical light, natural motion. No flicker, no dust, no text.

Hyper-realistic live-action period film. A vast gothic scriptorium full of real monks in wool habits bent over endless scrolls covered in spreadsheet grids, abacuses on the desks. The bearded monk in front, a real actor with weathered skin and an expressive face, rubs his forehead in despair, looks at the scroll, shakes his head and sighs. Behind him monks keep writing with quills; a long scroll slides off a desk and unrolls onto the floor. Steady shafts of daylight. Slow dolly forward. 35mm film, natural skin texture, realistic cloth, natural motion. No flicker, no text.

Hyper-realistic live-action film. A real man in a weathered hooded travelling cloak stands on a hilltop at sunrise, seen from behind, holding a large parchment map up in the wind; the map ripples, his cloak and the grass move in the breeze. Below, mist drifts over the Danube, the Chain Bridge and the Hungarian Parliament in Budapest. Slow arc around him. 35mm film, golden-hour light, natural motion. No text.

Hyper-realistic live-action period drama. A long council table in a torch-lit stone hall, crowded with real nobles in velvet and armour, a large hourglass in the middle. The older nobleman in front, head on his hand, slowly nods off, his head drops and he jerks awake; the woman beside him rolls her eyes; a knight drums his fingers; sand runs through the hourglass. Slow push-in along the table. 35mm film, natural faces and expressions, warm steady light. No flicker, no text.

Hyper-realistic live-action film. A towering mountain of paper scrolls and colourful sticky notes under dramatic clouds; sunbeams break through and sweep across it. At its foot a real man in a hooded cloak kneels and plants small coloured flags among neat stacks of scrolls, one by one; the flags flutter in the wind. Slow crane up. 35mm film, natural light, natural motion. No text.

Hyper-realistic live-action film. A torch-lit stone amphitheatre full of real students of all ages holding glowing tablets. On the stage a hooded teacher raises a staff toward three large glowing interlocking rings on the wall; the rings brighten softly. Students look up, then take notes on their tablets. Slow push-in. 35mm film, natural faces, warm steady light. No flicker, no text.

Hyper-realistic live-action fantasy film with a photoreal creature. A green dragon with finely detailed scales in a red velvet robe sits at a desk by a fireplace; he dips a quill, signs a long parchment scroll, eyes following the lines, then gives a small satisfied nod. A hooded man in the foreground watches, still. The fire burns calmly. Slow push-in. 35mm film, realistic textures and light. No flicker, no text.

Hyper-realistic live-action film. At night a real male runner in black running kit runs away from the camera along the wet stone embankment of the Danube in Budapest with a natural, steady stride; street lamps reflect in the wet cobbles; the illuminated Chain Bridge glows across the river. Steady tracking shot behind him. 35mm film, realistic night light. No rain, no flicker, no text.
